German Work Schedule Vocabulary: B1 Exercises

Practise Schicht, Gleitzeit, Überstunden and Teilzeit in fictional German work descriptions. Learn schedule terms with translated examples and answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Vocabulary and usage

Die Schicht is a work shift; die Gleitzeit means flexitime. Die Überstunden is plural and means overtime hours. Die Teilzeit describes part-time work, often in the expression in Teilzeit arbeiten. Schicht is countable: eine Schicht, zwei Schichten; Überstunden is used in the plural.

Common mistake to avoid

Teilzeit does not specify one fixed number of weekly hours. Gleitzeit describes flexibility within an arrangement, not unrestricted freedom to work at any time.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice each word’s meaning, article and common word partners in context.

Worked example 1Meine Schicht beginnt diese Woche um vierzehn Uhr.My shift starts at two p.m. this week.
Worked example 2In unserem Betrieb gibt es Gleitzeit.Our company offers flexitime.
Worked example 3Die Liste enthält die Überstunden des letzten Monats.The list includes last month's overtime hours.
Worked example 4Nach dem Kurs arbeitet er zunächst in Teilzeit.After the course he initially works part-time.

Practice: choose the matching word

Choose the word from the bank that matches the English cue and sentence. Use each item once; keep its spelling and capitalisation. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Gleitzeit · Schicht · Teilzeit · Überstunden

Question 1. Der geplante Arbeitsabschnitt von sechs bis vierzehn Uhr ist eine ___. (shift)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Schicht

Schicht names a scheduled block of work.

Question 2. Flexible Anfangszeiten im vereinbarten Rahmen nennt man ___. (flexitime)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Gleitzeit

Gleitzeit describes a flexible-hours arrangement.

Question 3. Zusätzliche Arbeitsstunden heißen ___. (overtime hours)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Überstunden

Überstunden is plural and refers to extra working hours.

Question 4. Sie arbeitet zwanzig Stunden pro Woche in ___. (part-time work)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Teilzeit

In Teilzeit arbeiten is the expression used in this example.
